info.title: goo observability API
info.description: Current development API served by one Go process. Browser paths under /api and unprefixed API paths dispatch to the same handlers, admission controls and state. No proxy or JSON reserialization boundary. Wire-shape schemas describe encoding, not all domain validation. Semantic constraints, custody and source effects remain authoritative in Go. Unknown input fields are rejected; null and omitted fields can decode and then fail domain validation. No authentication is implemented by this lab; cancellation IDs are local capabilities, not authorization.

get.description: Derived metadata search over immutable captures, literal case-insensitive title containment, optional exact kind/signal/environment, capture-time order. No telemetry reads or payload bodies. 10,000 nonreserved directory entries (two known index directories separately reserved), 16 MiB aggregate metadata, 64 KiB per metadata entry and 8 MiB retained summary JSON; missing index/budget refusal is 503. Metadata checksum and payload stat stamps do not establish payload content integrity; reopen and explicit rebuild verify full contents. Cursors bind query, admitted catalog IDs and metadata digests; changed scope/catalog is 400. Omitted environment matches any; present-empty matches exact empty. Direct ID reopen keeps its independent limits.

reportedStatus.description: Optional exact exporter StatusCode, independent of declared outcome. Omission means not retained in this evidence; empty and future values remain explicit unknown values. Legacy saved bytes are unchanged.

exploration.CaptureSummary.description: Bounded derived discovery metadata, not a partial receipt. No full question or evidence. Exact-ID reads verify authoritative contents. Environment null means unknown, distinct from exact empty.

exploration.CountedValuesResult.description: Exactly two bounded aggregate reads: complete count then complete string groups, with separate read clocks and content bases. changed_between_reads retains diagnostic observations but must not drive population actions. No source rows, result token, capture, native arithmetic or transactional snapshot.

state.description: Metadata capability state, including candidate. Not a service-health verdict, observed server count or semantic-convention conformance assertion.

families.description: Opt-in bounded family descriptors. HTTP/RPC/DB/messaging candidate metadata must be confirmed by the executable question before treating counts as observed; no hidden source read or fallback is performed by this planner.

nativeOptionsOmitted.description: Optional positive count of supported native options excluded by the 128-option display bound after exact-stream expansion. Omitted/zero preserves legacy wire bytes.

profile.description: Selected all-spans, http-server, rpc-server, db-client, messaging-consumer or messaging-producer family for opt-in requests; absent on legacy requests.

runtimeStreamsOmitted.description: Optional positive count of runtime preview streams clipped beyond first25 plus supplied bounded discovery omissions. This is not source absence or a count of validated executable options.

dbClientObserved.description: Optional advisory positive hint from already-held, same-scope Client span observations with a nonempty current db.system.name on the same row. false/omitted is unknown, not database absence or health. Auto prefers eligible HTTP then RPC before DB; no new source probe is implied.

httpServerObserved.description: Optional advisory positive hint from already-held, same-scope span observations. false/omitted means no positive hint, not HTTP absence; no new probe or semantic-convention compliance claim is implied.

messagingConsumerObserved.description: Optional advisory positive hint from already-held, same-scope Consumer spans with nonempty messaging.system on the same row. false/omitted is unknown, not absence, delivery success, acknowledgement or broker health. A compatible processing-duration histogram can independently admit the consumer family; it remains a separate population.

messagingProducerObserved.description: Optional advisory positive hint from already-held, same-scope Producer spans with nonempty messaging.system on the same row. false/omitted is unknown, not absence or delivery success. Consumer has automatic precedence; processing metrics never admit the producer family.

profile.description: Optional auto, all-spans, http-server, rpc-server, db-client, messaging-consumer or messaging-producer selection. Omitted/empty/null preserves the legacy v2 response. auto selects HTTP only with a positive supplied server-observation hint plus current-key metadata, or a compatible native HTTP instrument. Automatic precedence is HTTP, legacy RPC, DB client, messaging consumer, messaging producer, then All spans. RPC admission requires both legacy rpc.system/rpc.method keys plus a positive rpcServerObserved hint, or an eligible legacy RPC duration instrument. Flat keys alone leave All spans selected; hints are advisory, not authenticated conformance.

rpcServerObserved.description: Optional advisory positive hint from already-held, same-scope Server span observations with nonempty legacy rpc.system and rpc.method on the same row. false/omitted is unknown, not RPC absence or conformance. HTTP admission has automatic precedence; this does not authorize a probe.

family.description: Optional display/planning family identity; not a telemetry field or a shared native/span/log denominator.

exploration.PodDiscovery.description: One bounded UNION of five source-family resource-map/schema groups, not physical pod inventory or Kubernetes API state. More than1000groups refuses the entire request;100resource variants retained with omissions. No native authority, health, capacity, ownership or exact-map record join is inferred.

resourceSchemaURL.description: Explicit null for unrecorded trace-table resource schema; string including empty for known log/metric schema. These states remain distinct identities.

exploration.RecordAggregatesResult.description: Aggregate-only record projection: exactly count and groups reads plus one optional time-series read. Separate clocks/content bases do not establish a transactional snapshot. Changed aggregates are diagnostic and non-actionable. Never includes source rows, fields, plan, pagination or retention token.

value.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes; runtime enforces the byte limit.

measurements.ContainerCPUView.description: Replay-validated held container gauge evidence; independently useful signals, strict exact-resource/schema/attribute/observation/freshness alignment for rational percentages. No source reads, new custody, inferred health or missing-as-zero semantics.

measurements.ContainerMemoryView.description: Replay-validated held container gauge evidence; independently useful signals, strict exact-resource/schema/attribute/observation/freshness alignment for rational percentages. No source reads, new custody, inferred health or missing-as-zero semantics.

counterDomain.description: Optional per-stream counter-only exact exported decimal domain. Omitted keeps integer counter semantics. Host authority requires this opt-in; Pinned CPU-time defaults use cumulative seconds; explicitly expanded network/disk profiles certify whole byte counts below 2^53 and retain cumulative temporality.

stateProfile.description: Required only for kind state: pinned k8scluster-pod-phase/0.137.0 or k8scluster-container-ready/0.137.0 with matching exact resource authority. Unitless receiver gauges; no numeric arithmetic, probe-existence or health inference.

stockDomain.description: Optional stock-only nonnegative-integer policy. Recorded values must be integers >=0 and <2^53; missing-value flags remain unknown. Pinned filesystem stocks additionally require reported cumulative nonmonotonic export and strict source metadata. Empty/omitted keeps generic signed finite fractional stock semantics.

counterDomain.description: Optional per-stream counter-only exact exported decimal domain. Omitted keeps integer counter semantics. Host authority requires this opt-in; Pinned CPU-time defaults use cumulative seconds; explicitly expanded network/disk profiles certify whole byte counts below 2^53 and retain cumulative temporality.

stateProfile.description: Required only for kind state: pinned k8scluster-pod-phase/0.137.0 or k8scluster-container-ready/0.137.0 with matching exact resource authority. Unitless receiver gauges; no numeric arithmetic, probe-existence or health inference.

stockDomain.description: Optional stock-only nonnegative-integer policy. Recorded values must be integers >=0 and <2^53; missing-value flags remain unknown. Pinned filesystem stocks additionally require reported cumulative nonmonotonic export and strict source metadata. Empty/omitted keeps generic signed finite fractional stock semantics.

measurements.HostDashboardPlan.description: Pure retained-metadata planning. At most two independently evaluated default questions, with up to16 explicit exact-stream candidates. CPU logical cores/modes and memory states remain separate. No whole-host/fleet aggregation, derived capacity, saturation or health is inferred.

measurements.HostDiscovery.description: One bounded host-bearing metadata read over gauge/sum/histogram tables. Raw full resource maps/schemas remain separate identities. Unidentified source rows are not queried/countable; decoder missingHostIDRecords does not establish source absence. Metadata is not health/completeness.

resourceSchemaURL.description: Required reported resource schema including known empty string; unknown/null trace schema is refused before source access.
Required reported resource schema including known empty string; unknown/null trace schema is refused before source access.

measurements.PoolSignalsPlan.description: Pure supplied-metadata planning. Capacity/wait options are independent exact-stream questions, not fresh evidence or alignment/health/utilization claims. Preserves parent bounds; no source read, custody or publication.

measurements.PoolView.description: Pure composition of replay-validated held native evidence. Full identity, fixed bounds and observed stock times/epochs govern rational utilization; separate read clocks remain visible. No source read, custody, capture or transactional observation is created.

id.description: Exact reported host.id, k8s.pod.uid or container.id for the selected resource kind; never a name, normalized runtime ID or manufactured service/instance identity.

delta.description: Exact canonical base-ten interval difference, present only for ok intervals. Decimal differences can be longer than individual input values.

exactPerSecond.description: Reduced exact nonnegative rational rate for opted-in decimal counters, in source units per second. perSecond is its finite floating-point display approximation.

valueDomain.description: Explicit bounded nonnegative decimal arithmetic. Omitted retains uint64 input/count semantics.

metrics.CounterResult.description: Per-stream native counter intervals. Explicit decimal domain adds exact decimal deltas/rational rates; count ratios/fleet and window-comparison contracts do not accept that domain. Unknown intervals have no rate; resets, gaps, missing values and clipped boundaries are not interpolated.

metrics.StateResult.description: Exact-stream categorical observations. state is observation quality; codeState is supported/unsupported domain decoding. Fresh reported phase Unknown is observed. Unsupported finite codes retain raw code and quality without a label.

metrics.StockResult.description: Per-stream cumulative nonmonotonic sum observations. Signed finite fractional values and accumulation epochs are preserved; decreases are not resets. No delta integration, fleet total, rate, capacity or utilization is inferred.

value.description: Finite observed cumulative tally, possibly signed/fractional. Omitted when unknown; stale observations retain their value.

baselineCapture.description: Optional exact immutable raw-span duration capture ID. Publication verifies stored evidence and same environment; opening a view stages configuration without loading evidence or starting telemetry. Omitted/empty preserves legacy identity.

RuntimeCapabilities.description: Source-free startup configuration only. Configured does not establish source availability, authorization, telemetry coverage, ingestion completeness or service health.

UIConfig.description: Pure Go startup configuration. Does not query or report readiness of ClickHouse.

Liveness.description: The Go HTTP process is running; no source or ingestion check.

x-contract-notes: Go accepts any request Content-Type; application/json is the supported client encoding.
Browser /api and unprefixed API requests have the same byte limits, headers, cancellation and streaming semantics.
JSON receive is bounded to 15 seconds and interrupted by request cancellation; successful decoding clears the receive deadline before source/response work.
Operation GET validation uses http.Error text/plain with JSON-looking text; /api preserves that status, type and body.
Tail early JSON errors omit Cache-Control; streaming responses set no-store and X-Accel-Buffering: no.
Health is process liveness only; it does not query ClickHouse or certify telemetry ingestion.
No generated handlers, semantic validator replacement, API stability guarantee or new authorization layer is introduced.
